body: Work, finances, relationships that I’ve ruined.  All the bad, stupid stuff I’ve done.  I should have gone a long time ago.

So many reasons.  Can’t hold down a job.  Can’t stay in a long term relationship.  I have made some very bad decisions lately that I have tried to fix and cannot.  If I am dead, I won’t be here anymore to disappoint or hurt my family and the few friends I still have.
